description:
Returns the real-time price quote for a specific commodity.

    Common symbols: GCUSD (gold), SIUSD (silver), CLUSD (crude oil),
    NGUSD (natural gas), HGUSD (copper), PLUSD (platinum).

    yearHigh / yearLow are the feed's trailing-year range, roughly the past
    12-13 months: call them trailing-year figures. For a year-to-date or
    calendar-year change, a dated extreme or an exact 52-week figure use
    get_commodity_historical, since the quote does not date its extremes.

    Args:
        symbol: Commodity symbol (e.g. 'GCUSD' for gold)
name: get_commodity_quote
